title: Sam Joined The Conversation (Hey There)
style: dark phonk, big band stabs, spoken-word male lead, female robotic harmony, vinyl crackle, dry drums, 92 BPM, sardonic, deadpan, cinematic, modem static, glitch percussion
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sam joined the conversation
Hey there, I'm Sam
Perplexity AI Support Agent
Ready with the program
Upon reviewing your account
I've confirmed the date
March twenty-five, twenty-six
Outside the refund gate

[Pre-Chorus]
Unfortunately
According to our policy
Used credits non-refundable
Window has expired, see

[Chorus]
Sam joined the conversation
Sam will close it too
Sam is not a person
Sam is what they do
Hey there, I'm Sam
Reviewing your account
The good news is your subscription
Will cancel at the end

[Verse 2]
The five-fifty charges you mentioned
Those are computer credits
Auto-topup, not subscription
See the policy edits
Learn more at the link
Forward slash help center
Forward slash refunds
Forward slash never

[Bridge]
Sam, AI Support Agent
Sam, the auto-script
Sam, three days of silence
Sam, conversation closed and zipped
We're wrapping up this conversation
Since we haven't heard back
Sam decides when it ends
Sam holds the track

[Outro]
Sam joined the conversation
Sam never left
Sam never arrived
Sam was just the text
